relations: Right hand fingers curl over apple, keeping it steady on the black cutting board.
Knife blade dips and rocks against the rightmost apple piece, shifting its angle and height.
Cut wedges and slices at left remain undisturbed while the active cut progresses.
Holding hand moves slightly forward as the knife continues, with surrounding mise en place fixed.
caption: The video captures an overhead view of a stainless-steel counter centered on a black cutting board. A person is mid-way through slicing a green apple. The right forearm extends from the upper right, fingers curling over the apple portion to hold it steady. The other hand's fingertips appear at the top edge, guiding a thin knife. The blade dips and rocks in short repeated strokes against the rightmost piece. Its angle and height shift from frame to frame as the cut progresses. To the left lie already-cut pieces, a flat wedge and two upright slices, that remain undisturbed with no new slice visibly separating off. The hand holding the apple shifts slightly forward as the knife works through the slice. Around the board the mise en place stays fixed: a wicker basket of apple slices, cherry tomatoes, garlic and herb sprigs; glass bowls of red powder, beetroot, arugula and pale mustard; peppercorns and oil; white shakers; and a plate rim. The camera holds its top-down position without movement.
